title: Endpoint Telemetry: login_event v1
description: Raw telemetry event emitted when a login, logout, or authentication event is detected on an endpoint by the EDR agent. Distinct from identity telemetry (which originates from SSO/cloud identity providers).

user.description: Username that authenticated or attempted to authenticate. Normalizer maps to 'user' field.

action.description: Specific authentication action. Normalizer maps to 'event_type' field.

source_ip.description: IP address from which the login was initiated (relevant for remote/network logons).

logon_type.description: Windows logon type. Maps to Event ID 4624/4625 LogonType field. Omit on non-Windows.

failure_reason.description: Human-readable reason for authentication failure. Omit on success.

workstation.description: Name of the workstation where the login originated (for network logons).
